items.title: October's ERA5-Land monthly data
items.site_change: The tracker moves from its before-winter state to tracking: October's tile fills in for each region.
items.prepare: The hard-line item (ACTION_PLAN Phase 5, D55): set ERA5_LAG_MONTHS from 3 to 1, download every published 2026 month to a stamped path (D73), refit SPEI (about 55 minutes), rebuild the tables and report the changed numbers. Recheck TRACKER_DATA_DAY against the day October appeared. Needs the stamped download paths built first.

items.title: November's ERA5-Land monthly data
items.site_change: November's tile fills in on the tracker for each region.
items.prepare: Download November 2026 to a stamped path, rebuild the tracker tables, render the site. Record the day CPC posted this month's RONI value.

items.title: CNFDB 2025 fire polygons (no fixed date)
items.site_change: The 2025 seasons of BC, AB and YT are reported beside the results; the registered tests keep 1984 to 2024.
items.prepare: Check the CNFDB release folder for new file dates. If released: download to a stamped path (D73), read the release notes, report beside (D57). For the sibling, the start-month split of the scored seasons is built from the same pieces (src.fire_after_date.split_table, scoring_day_seasons) and handed over with the outcome; reading a later retrieval's fire files into pieces is still to build (DECISIONS 2026-10-13). Reads polygons: ask the owner first.
items.basis: ROLLOUT_WINDOWS; frozen plan deviations log (D57): about January 2027

items.title: California's 2026 fire season closes
items.site_change: The 2026 season can be shown complete for every US region, still provisional (WFIGS) and outside the tests.
items.prepare: Download WFIGS again to a stamped path and redraw the 2026 season for PNW, AK, NorCal and SoCal: described only, provisional, outside the tests (owner, 2026-10-12; D95). For the sibling, the start-month split of the scored seasons is built from the same pieces (src.fire_after_date.split_table, scoring_day_seasons) and handed over with the outcome; reading a later retrieval's fire files into pieces is still to build (DECISIONS 2026-10-13). Reads polygons: ask the owner first.
items.basis: FIRE_SEASON_MONTHS (D43); ANALYSIS_PLAN Execution details: 2026 is described only; D95

items.prepare: Check the Zenodo concept record for a v9. If released: read its terms (read-licence), download to a stamped path, rebuild the station index.

items.title: The December to February El Niño index (RONI), first release
items.site_change: The winter is classed as El Niño, strong El Niño or neither, and the first forecast stage is published from the registered model.
items.prepare: Fetch CPC's first RONI release after February to a stamped path the day it appears and record the retrieval date: the frozen plan fixes that release as the forecast's input. Then run the 2027 forecast from the H3a model for all seven regions with 80% intervals.
items.basis: ROLLOUT_WINDOWS; ANALYSIS_PLAN Execution details, The 2027 forecast

items.title: Snowpack on 1 April (ERA5-Land)
items.site_change: The final forecast stage is published, with the two snowpack and winter moisture forecasts beside it, and the tracker becomes the record of what arrived when.
items.prepare: Download the 1 April hourly field to a stamped path, rebuild the snowpack table, run the secondary H6 forecasts, move the tracker to its final state.

items.title: Revisions to the December to February index end
items.site_change: Any revision is reported beside the forecast; the forecast keeps the first release.
items.prepare: Fetch RONI again to a stamped path, compare the December to February value with the first release, report the difference.
items.basis: RONI_REVISION_MONTHS; ANALYSIS_PLAN: later revisions are reported, not substituted

items.title: The 2027 fire season ends in PNW, BC, AB, AK and YT
items.site_change: The verification panel sets what burned against the forecast for PNW and AK, from WFIGS and marked provisional. BC, AB and YT follow when NBAC holds 2027.
items.prepare: Download WFIGS to a stamped path and measure 2027 for PNW and AK (provisional). BC, AB and YT wait: their registered source, CNFDB, arrives about January 2029 on its release record, and NBAC stands in as a provisional source from about May 2028 (D93). For the sibling, the start-month split of the scored seasons is built from the same pieces (src.fire_after_date.split_table, scoring_day_seasons) and handed over with the outcome; reading a later retrieval's fire files into pieces is still to build (DECISIONS 2026-10-13). Reads polygons: ask the owner first.

items.title: NBAC burned-area polygons for 2027 (no fixed date)
items.site_change: The verification panel gains BC, AB and YT, measured from NBAC and marked provisional.
items.prepare: Check the NBAC download folder for a release holding 2027. If released: download to a stamped path, measure the 2027 season of BC, AB and YT under the fire rules, and report it as provisional: the registered series is CNFDB, and NBAC maps fires CNFDB does not hold (2.0% to 3.1% of its area, 1984 to 2024). Reads polygons: ask the owner first.
items.basis: ROLLOUT_WINDOWS; NBAC release record (v20260513 held 2025); D93

items.title: CNFDB 2027 fire polygons (no fixed date)
items.site_change: The registered source's 2027 figures for BC, AB and YT are set beside the provisional NBAC ones, and the difference is reported.
items.prepare: Check the CNFDB release folder for 2027. If released: download to a stamped path, measure BC, AB and YT, and report beside the NBAC figures already published; neither replaces the other without a note. For the sibling, the start-month split of BC, AB and YT 2027 is built from these CNFDB pieces and handed over with this outcome, as for CNFDB 2025; no split is built from NBAC, which has no ignition date (DECISIONS 2026-10-13). Reads polygons: ask the owner first.
